findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can terminate the agreement immediately without cause and without paying you for your work, leaving you uncompensated.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement with written notice, and the Contractor waives any claim to payment for work already delivered.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery rather than upon full payment, creating a risk if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment, and the Contractor waives any claim to payment for work already delivered.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am looking forward to working together and would like to propose a few minor adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the clause on termination, the text currently allows the client to end the agreement immediately without notice or payment for completed work. I propose modifying this so that either party may terminate with written notice, ensuring payment for work already delivered. - Regarding the clause on intellectual property, ownership currently transfers upon delivery rather than upon full payment. I propose modifying this so that intellectual property rights transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your feedback.
